name: stada-omnichannel
description: In-house Rx omnichannel platform for Stada Kazakhstan (MVP)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.render-build: npm ci --prefix server --omit=dev && npm ci --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
